title: About Me
text:
My name is Kate Lussier, and I am from Kingston, NH. I am a current student at UNH getting my M.S. in Molecular and Cellular Biotechnology. I graduated with my B.S. in Biomedical Science: Medical Microbiology from UNH in May 2026. I work part-time at Lonza as an Upstream MSAT Technology Transfer Co-op. I’m excited to keep growing in areas like biological therapies and tissue engineering, and I’m ready to bring that energy to a team working to bridge lab research and real patient outcomes. Please always feel free to reach out via LinkedIn, I’m always looking for opportunities to grow my skillset, and my network.
